title: CharacterBody2D move_and_slide() treats wall corner as a floor, preventing the CharacterBody2D from falling
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in 4.0.stable, 4.1.stable, 4.2.stable, 4.3.stable, 4.4.stable, 4.4.1.stable, 4.5.beta6. ### System information Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8400 CPU @ 2.80GHz (6 threads) ### Issue description When positioning a ```CharacterBody2D``` and another collision object like ```StaticBody2D``` or a ```TileMap``` tile with a collision shape in a particular way: (the green square is a ```CharacterBody2D``` and the blue square is a ```StaticBody2D```, the grid squares are the 1 pixel big) and moving the ```CharacterBody2D``` with ```move_and_slide()``` while applying gravity to it, ```move_and_slide()``` treats the collision with the wall (in this case the left edge of the ```StaticBody2D```) like a floor collision and prevents the ```CharacterBody2D``` from falling: while having ```is_on_floor()``` return false. ### Steps to reproduce - Create a ```CharacterBody2D``` and add to it a ```CollisionShape2D``` with shape ```RectangleShape2D```. - Attach to the ```CharacterBody2D``` the a script with the following movement code: ```gdscript extends CharacterBody2D const GRAVITY := 24 const VELOCITY_Y_MAX := 600 func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void: velocity.y = clamp(velocity.y + GRAVITY, -VELOCITY_Y_MAX, VELOCITY_Y_MAX) move_and_slide() print(is_on_floor()) return ``` - Create a ```StaticBody2D``` and add to it a ```CollisionShape2D``` with shape ```RectangleShape2D```. - Position the ```StaticBody2D``` such that its left (or right) edge is on the same line of the right (or left) edge of the ```CharacterBody2D```, and its top edge is (at least) two pixels below the bottom edge of the ```CharacterBody2D```. - Run the scene. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [minimal_reproduction_project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21955784/minimal_reproduction_project.zip)
